findings.title: Consent, suppression and delivery missing

findings.action: Implement auditable recipient consent, opt-outs, suppression, sending and event handling before claiming delivery functionality.

findings.title: Evaluation scope and regression

findings.action: Compare available checkpoints; evaluate all validation prompts and an untouched test set; add human review and a real personalization ablation.
